subject.title: [Feature]: Integrate password toggle functionality across all platforms to let users see password in clear text

question: Should credential reveal state reset to masked-by-default per field, or may OpenClaw persist visibility preferences across sessions and platforms?
rationale: The feature is useful, but persistent clear-text visibility changes credential exposure behavior and needs explicit product/security intent before implementation.

options.title: Ephemeral Reveal Only
options.body: Implement per-field reveal buttons that reset to masked by default and do not persist visibility across sessions.

options.title: Persist Visibility Preference
options.body: Allow local persistence only after maintainers explicitly accept the exposure tradeoff and define reset behavior.

options.title: Defer Broad Rollout
options.body: Keep the existing partial web behavior until maintainers complete a credential-field inventory and platform plan.

recommendation.title: Ephemeral Reveal Only
recommendation.body: Implement per-field reveal buttons that reset to masked by default and do not persist visibility across sessions.
